raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Extend the existing ModelOpt online weight-export stream to carry current Q/K/V attention scales and canonical KV-cache metadata for native inference refits.

## Merge dependency

**Do not merge until [ModelOpt #3121](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer/pull/3121) is merged and Bridge uses a compatible published ModelOpt version.**

- ModelOpt #3121 is required for stateless constant-amax FP8/NVFP4 KV-scale capture. The underlying functional KV API from [ModelOpt #2981](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer/pull/2981) is already merged.
- A ModelOpt release or RC containing both changes must be available, and Bridge's ModelOpt dependency and lockfile must be updated before this PR merges. The current `0.48.0rc1` pin is insufficient.
- Re-run the KV export tests with that published dependency and require the KV cases to run without skips. Source-installed qualification does not verify the published dependency combination.

# Changelog

- Support symmetric FP8 and NVFP4 KV-only export plans, as well as KV scales alongside quantized weights.
- Capture local scales once during per-stream preparation and emit them once on the owning QKV task's first converted output, including renamed outputs. An absent, disabled or constant-amax Q quantizer exports scale one; calibrated Q uses the TP maximum across local heads. K/V scales must still agree across TP, and online FP8 scales are not clamped to one.
- Reject rotations and pre-quant scaling even on disabled attention quantizers. Validate the supported FP8/block-16 NVFP4 layouts and reject enabled custom backends during planning and plan reuse. Offline KV-cache saving remains unsupported.
- Document the online usage, consumer responsibilities, and ModelOpt prerequisites.

```python
plan = bridge.build_hf_modelopt_export_plan(model)
quantization_config = plan.quantization_config

for name, tensor in bridge.export_hf_weights_modelopt(model, export_plan=plan):
    refit_engine.replace_weight(name, tensor)
```

Every distributed rank must build the plan and fully consume each stream in the same order. The consumer owns native cache storage and attention/CUDA-graph refresh; this PR does not introduce a new tensor transport or quantization implementation.

# GitHub Actions CI

CI results are available in the PR checks. No CI workflow, dependency pin, lockfile, or Megatron-Core gitlink changes are included.

This feature requires ModelOpt's functional KV-cache export API from [ModelOpt #2981](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer/pull/2981), plus [ModelOpt #3121](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer/pull/3121) for stateless constant-amax FP8/NVFP4. The currently pinned ModelOpt package predates the KV API, so the new KV test cases can be skipped in that environment. A green result with those cases skipped does not qualify the feature. A compatible published ModelOpt dependency remains required before merge; the native qualification below installed the candidate ModelOpt source explicitly.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

- [x] Read and followed the contributor guidelines.
- [x] Added focused unit tests and extended the existing prepared-plan regression fixture.
- [x] Updated the programmatic ModelOpt export documentation.
- [x] Optional ModelOpt functionality is imported only when needed; tests declare their functional-KV API requirement.
  - [ ] Reviewer: verify optional dependency handling.
- [x] Qualify combined weight+KV native refit, GRPO execution and checkpoint resume through colocated CUDA IPC.
- [ ] Qualify native collective transport and broader TP/PP configurations.
- [ ] Select compatible published ModelOpt dependencies.

# Additional Information

## Testing

```bash
uv run python -m pytest -o addopts= -q \
  tests/unit_tests/models/test_modelopt_kv.py \
  tests/unit_tests/models/test_modelopt_utils.py::test_auto_bridge_can_reuse_a_prepared_plan
```

- After merging current main, both full ModelOpt export test modules ran: **207 passed, one failed during Gloo initialization before export**. That one case then passed unchanged in isolation on both the incoming base and this candidate; no timeout or product-code workaround was added. Coverage includes combined quantized-QKV + KV companions, plan reuse, renamed outputs, calibrated Q reduction across TP, strict K/V agreement and preparation-time error propagation. The earlier focused run passed all 131 cases with zero skips; the previous source fails four renamed-output cases and the differing-Q TP case.
- Four-rank prepared-plan export checks at TP2/PP2 passed with both Gloo and NCCL for FP8 and NVFP4. These exercise real QKV mapping/collectives, repeated streams, renamed outputs, a rank-local missing calibration buffer, and K/V disagreement. They qualify Bridge export groups, not multi-rank NeMo-RL training or native inference refit.
- Isolated 64-layer preparation + KV-companion export on one GB200 node (TP2/PP2, NCCL): warmed median **212.0 ms before → 66.9 ms after**, with a repeated before control of **212.4 ms**; ten measured iterations per arm using the same ModelOpt source. This excludes weight conversion, full weight transport, generation and training. The change removes per-layer error-object collectives and Bridge's explicit finite-value check; the tensor broadcast/gather and K/V consistency check remain.
- All 94 new negative cases failed against the original implementation because unsupported settings were accepted, then passed with the validation fix. The rotated NVFP4 recipe includes disabled-Q rotation; disabled custom backends remain allowed.
- `uv run --no-project --with pre-commit pre-commit run --all-files` passed.
- Strict mypy on the changed source reports six existing missing-stub/`py.typed` import diagnostics, unchanged before and after the fix. This is not a clean strict-type-check pass.
- These unit tests alone do not establish native training or attention numerical parity. The separate GPU qualification below covers combined refit and training through colocated CUDA IPC.

## Native training qualification

Qwen3-0.6B, synchronous NeMo-RL GRPO, global batch 4, total sequence limit 256, two colocated GPUs, learner DP2 and TP/PP/CP/EP1, FlashInfer, CUDA decode graphs enabled and captured. All cases used the same NVFP4 W4A16 MLP weight quantization.

| KV cache | Scales | Two scheduled steps + native resume to step 3 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FP8 E4M3 | Calibrated | Passed |
| FP8 E4M3 | Constant amax 448 | Passed |
| NVFP4 | Calibrated | Passed |
| NVFP4 | Constant amax 448 | Passed |

All four cases had finite loss/gradient metrics, with nonzero gradients at steps 2 and 3. The first scheduled step had no valid training tokens. Each fresh process loaded the actual step-2 checkpoint, then saved step 3. Restricted inspection of the native checkpoint records confirmed identical K/V quantizer settings and amax across resume for all 28 layers, Q disabled and K/V enabled, Adam step 2→3, and scheduler/consumed-sample counters 8→12. Calibrated cases retained 56 K/V amax buffers; constant cases retained the stateless constant setting without creating amax buffers. Optimizer moment records were present; bitwise equivalence to uninterrupted training was not tested.

The qualification used this PR at `4e84c507`, ModelOpt #3121 at `c7421a98`, vLLM 0.29.0, Torch 2.13.0, TE 2.18.0, and a compatible Transformers 5.18.0 learner environment (vLLM used 5.12.1). That historical training preceded the later constant-scale scoping and review cleanups; the current export tests above cover those source changes, without repeating native training. The downstream NeMo-RL consumer is separate from this PR. This does not establish an out-of-the-box published dependency combination, attention numerical parity, convergence, throughput, native collective refit, or TP/PP greater than one.

Suggested merge order: ModelOpt prerequisites, this Bridge feature with compatible dependencies, then the separate NeMo-RL KV integration. This PR does not change NeMo-RL. The small functional training results above do not establish learning quality or performance.

After merging main, 207 tests passed; one Gloo-init timeout passed unchanged when retried on both base and candidate. TP2/PP2 Gloo/NCCL export checks pass. The isolated 64-layer preparation and KV-companion cost fell from 212 ms to 67 ms (repeat control: 212 ms); this excludes full refit and training. Offline KV export remains a follow-up.

Thanks, 88eb5621 addresses all three:
1. Q now uses the TP maximum while K/V must still agree; `test_kv_tp_scales_use_query_max_and_require_matching_kv` covers both.
2. Scales are emitted on the QKV task's first output, so renamed outputs keep them (the new `rename_query` case).
3. Capture and the finite/positive check moved into `prepare_modelopt_export_tasks` under its existing error collective; the per-layer object collectives are gone.

I ran `test_modelopt_kv.py` and `test_modelopt_utils.py` at 7898dc06 on nemo 26.10.rc9 with ModelOpt main (56c048c, including #3121): 208 passed. LGTM.

@@ -206,6 +206,32 @@ Post-mapping key renames of quantized weights are not supported, including legac
 excluded weights retain their normal renaming behavior. This API requires a ModelOpt release that provides the
 functional quantized-weight export interface.
 
+#### KV-cache scales in online export
+
+The streaming API also supports symmetric FP8 and NVFP4 K/V quantizers on standard
+QKV-mapped attention layers. It supports both KV-only models with unquantized weights
+and combined weight/KV quantization. Build the plan after calibration and pass its
+`quantization_config` to the inference engine, as in the examples above.
+
+FP8 requires static per-tensor E4M3 quantization. NVFP4 requires block-16 E2M1
+quantization with dynamic E4M3 block scales and a static global scale. Enabled
+query quantizers must use the FP8 layout. Rotation and pre-quant scaling are rejected
+even on disabled quantizers; enabled custom quantization backends are also unsupported.
+The same checks run when a plan is reused.
+
+Each stream emits current `q_scale`, `k_scale`, and `v_scale` tensors under the
+attention's Hugging Face prefix, once per QKV conversion group. An absent, disabled or
+constant-amax query quantizer exports a Q scale of one. Calibrated Q scales use the
+maximum across TP ranks to cover all query heads; K/V scales must agree across TP.
+FP8 scales are not clamped to one in this online
+path. The consumer remains responsible for native cache allocation and for refreshing
+any captured attention coefficients when scales change.
+
+This requires ModelOpt's functional KV-cache export API; constant-amax FP8 recipes
+also require constant-amax export support. Asymmetric K/V formats, partially selected
+attention layers, and attention without a supported QKV mapping are rejected. Offline
+`save_hf_pretrained_modelopt()` KV-cache export remains unsupported.
+
 ### Fake-Quantized Hugging Face Export
 
 `AutoBridge.save_hf_pretrained()` and `save_hf_weights()` also save a fake-quantized ModelOpt model, for

@@ -0,0 +1,200 @@

+#

+# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+# You may obtain a copy of the License at
+#
+#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+#
+# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+
+"""Attention scale companions for the shared ModelOpt weight exporter."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.model_bridge import HFWeightTuple, WeightConversionTask
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.quant_mapping import derive_kv_bmm_amax_map
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.utils import get_module_and_param_from_name
+
+
+def _kv_spec(attention: torch.nn.Module) -> tuple[str, bool] | None:
+    quantizers = [getattr(attention, f"{name}_bmm_quantizer", None) for name in ("q", "k", "v")]
+    # ModelOpt applies these transforms even when quantization is disabled.
+    # Scalar scale companions cannot describe or compensate for either one.
+    for name, quantizer in zip(("Q", "K", "V"), quantizers, strict=True):
+        if quantizer is None:
+            continue
+        if getattr(quantizer, "rotate_is_enabled", False):
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"ModelOpt {name} export does not support rotation")
+        if getattr(quantizer, "pre_quant_scale", None) is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"ModelOpt {name} export does not support pre-quant scaling")
+    enabled = [quantizer is not None and quantizer.is_enabled for quantizer in quantizers]
+    if not any(enabled):
+        return None
+
+    # Keep weight-only export usable with ModelOpt versions predating the KV API.
+    from modelopt.torch.export.quantized_weight_export import get_kv_cache_export_spec
+
+    spec = get_kv_cache_export_spec(attention)
+    if spec not in ("FP8", "NVFP4"):
+        raise NotImplementedError(f"ModelOpt export requires symmetric FP8 or NVFP4 KV caches, got {spec!r}")
+    for name, quantizer, is_enabled in zip(("Q", "K", "V"), quantizers, enabled, strict=True):
+        if quantizer is None or not is_enabled:
+            continue
+        if getattr(quantizer, "backend", None) is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"ModelOpt {name} export does not support custom quantization backends")
+        fp8 = name == "Q" or spec == "FP8"
+        block_sizes = None if fp8 else {-1: 16, "type": "dynamic", "scale_bits": (4, 3)}
+        if (
+            quantizer.num_bits != ((4, 3) if fp8 else (2, 1))
+            or quantizer.axis is not None
+            or quantizer.block_sizes != block_sizes
+            or quantizer._dynamic
+            or getattr(quantizer, "bias", None) is not None
+            or getattr(quantizer, "bias_value", None) is not None
+        ):
+            layout = "per-tensor E4M3" if fp8 else "block-16 E2M1 with dynamic E4M3 block scales"
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"ModelOpt {name} export requires static symmetric {layout} quantization")
+    return spec, enabled[0]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _KVExportHook:
+    task: WeightConversionTask
+    attention: torch.nn.Module | None
+    hf_parent: str
+    spec: tuple[str, bool] | None
+    values: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    def validate(self) -> None:
+        if self.attention is not None and _kv_spec(self.attention) != self.spec:
+            raise ValueError(f"ModelOpt KV configuration changed for {self.task.global_param_name}")
+
+    def __call__(self, hf_name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Iterable[HFWeightTuple]:
+        yield HFWeightTuple(hf_name, tensor)
+        if self.spec is None:
+            return
+        yield from self.scales()
+
+    def capture(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        self.validate()
+        if self.spec is None or self.attention is None:
+            return None
+        from modelopt.torch.export.quantized_weight_export import capture_kv_cache_export_state
+
+        state = capture_kv_cache_export_state(self.attention, clamp_fp8_scales=False, cpu=False)
+        if state is None:
+            raise ValueError("KV quantizers were disabled after export planning")
+        q_scale = torch.ones_like(state.k_scale)
+        if self.spec[1] and not self.attention.q_bmm_quantizer._use_constant_amax:
+            from modelopt.torch.export.quant_utils import get_scaling_factor
+
+            q_scale = get_scaling_factor(self.attention.q_bmm_quantizer)
+            if q_scale is None:
+                raise ValueError("Missing calibrated query scale")
+        scalars = (q_scale, state.k_scale, state.v_scale)
+        if any(value.numel() != 1 for value in scalars):
+            raise ValueError("ModelOpt attention export requires scalar Q/K/V scales")
+        return torch.stack(
+            [
+                value.detach().to(device=self.task.param_weight.device, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(())
+                for value in scalars
+            ]
+        )
+
+    def scales(self) -> Iterable[HFWeightTuple]:
+        if self.spec is None:
+            return
+        # Imported here to avoid a cycle: the shared exporter constructs these hooks.
+        from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.modelopt_utils import _stage_tensor_for_collective
+
+        values = self.values
+        mapping = self.task.mapping
+        if values is not None:
+            values = _stage_tensor_for_collective(values, mapping.pp_group)
+        values = mapping.broadcast_from_pp_rank(values, cache_key=f"modelopt:kv:{self.task.global_param_name}")
+        if values is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Missing ModelOpt attention scales for {self.task.global_param_name}")
+        values = _stage_tensor_for_collective(values, mapping.tp_group)
+        shards = mapping.gather_from_tp_ranks(values)
+        if any(not torch.equal(shard[1:], shards[0][1:]) for shard in shards[1:]):
+            raise ValueError(f"Inconsistent ModelOpt K/V scales across TP for {self.task.global_param_name}")
+        # Q calibration is local to each TP rank's heads; deployment needs one range.
+        q_scale = shards[0][0] if len(shards) == 1 else torch.stack([shard[0] for shard in shards]).amax()
+        for name, value in zip(("q", "k", "v"), (q_scale, values[1], values[2]), strict=True):
+            yield HFWeightTuple(f"{self.hf_parent}.{name}_scale", value.clone())
+
+
+def _local_kv_hooks(tasks: list[WeightConversionTask], model: list[torch.nn.Module]) -> dict[str, _KVExportHook]:
+    hooks: dict[str, _KVExportHook] = {}
+    mapped_attention_ids = set()
+    quantized_attention = {
+        id(module): name
+        for chunk in model
+        for name, module in chunk.named_modules()
+        if any(
+            quantizer is not None and quantizer.is_enabled
+            for axis in ("q", "k", "v")
+            for quantizer in (getattr(module, f"{axis}_bmm_quantizer", None),)
+        )
+    }
+    attention_with_quantizers = {
+        id(module)
+        for chunk in model
+        for module in chunk.modules()
+        if any(getattr(module, f"{axis}_bmm_quantizer", None) is not None for axis in ("q", "k", "v"))
+    }
+    if not attention_with_quantizers:
+        return hooks
+    for task in tasks:
+        mappings = derive_kv_bmm_amax_map([task.mapping])
+        if not mappings or task.megatron_module is None:
+            continue
+        local_parent = task.param_name.removesuffix(".linear_qkv.weight") + ".core_attention"
+        _, attention = get_module_and_param_from_name(model, local_parent, task.vp_stage)
+        if id(attention) not in attention_with_quantizers:
+            continue
+        mapped_attention_ids.add(id(attention))
+        spec = _kv_spec(attention)

+    plan = modelopt_utils.build_modelopt_export_plan([task], model=[model])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        weight_export,
+        "capture_kv_cache_export_state",
+        lambda *_args, **_kwargs: SimpleNamespace(k_scale=torch.tensor(bad_scale), v_scale=torch.tensor(1.0)),
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="finite and positive"):
+        modelopt_utils.prepare_modelopt_export_tasks(plan)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("axis", ["q", "k", "v"])
+def test_kv_tp_scales_use_query_max_and_require_matching_kv(monkeypatch, axis):
+    model, _attention, task = _model_and_task(query=True)
+    plan = modelopt_utils.build_modelopt_export_plan([task], model=[model])
+    hook = modelopt_utils.prepare_modelopt_export_tasks(plan)[0].export_hook
+
+    def gather(value):
+        peer = value.clone()
+        peer[("q", "k", "v").index(axis)] *= 2
+        return [value, peer]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(task.mapping, "gather_from_tp_ranks", gather)
+    if axis == "q":
+        exported = dict(hook(task.mapping.hf_param["q"], task.param_weight))
+        assert exported["model.layers.0.self_attn.q_scale"].item() == 1.0
+        assert exported["model.layers.0.self_attn.k_scale"].item() == 0.25
+        assert exported["model.layers.0.self_attn.v_scale"].item() == 0.125
+    else:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="scales across TP"):
+            list(hook(task.mapping.hf_param["q"], task.param_weight))
+
+
+def test_remote_kv_capture_propagates_owner_failure(monkeypatch):
+    model, _attention, task = _model_and_task()
+    plan = modelopt_utils.build_modelopt_export_plan([task], model=[model])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(modelopt_utils, "_all_gather_objects", lambda value, _group: [value, "owner capture failed"])
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="owner capture failed"):
+        modelopt_utils.prepare_modelopt_export_tasks(plan)
